messages:
Maya L.: Quick note — autotuner is picking FlashAttention v3 for causal runs but v2 for non-causal on our A100/RTX pools. Seeing a perf cliff when head_dim==48, tail latency spikes on long sequences. flame graph attached in thread.
Kevin P.: I can repro. Looks like the kernel selector prefers v3 when arch>=sm80 and seqlen>1024, but v3 has an awkward slowpath for head_dim%64 != 0. head=48 triggers fallback matmul.
Sasha R.: Repro script (small):
```python
# repro flashattn pick
import torch
from model_stub import run_forward
cfg = {"seq_len": 1536, "heads": 16, "head_dim": 48, "causal": True}
run_forward(cfg)
```
Kevin P.: Profiling shows extra memcpy around KV cache switch when we change kernel between requests — so throughput drops even though single-call latency improves in some cases.
Maya L.: Triage: is this mostly causal vs non-causal split or also quantization/packed layout dependent?
Kevin P.: Mainly causal flag + head dim right now. Quantized runs hit similar issue because int8 kernels have stricter alignment requirements.
Sasha R.: Proposed heuristic: autotuner should include (head_dim % 16 == 0) and kv_cache_layout invariant when scoring kernel options. Also prefer older v2 for head_dim in {48,56} until we fix v3 slowpath.
InfraBot: CI canary deployed with env `FORCE_FLASH_V2_HEAD48=true` to staging pool. Canary results: tail latency -18%, median +2% (slightly worse), throughput -2% on mixed workload.
Triage Bot: Created ticket <https://redwood.atlassian.net/browse/INF-3421> "flashattn v3 slowpath for non-64-aligned head dims causes kv-cache memcpy and tail spikes".
Kevin P.: Patch idea (pseudo):
```diff
- selector.score += arch_weight + seqlen_weight
+ selector.score += arch_weight + seqlen_weight
+ if head_dim % 64 != 0 and kernel=="v3": selector.score -= large_penalty
```
Sasha R.: I'll run ablations across Ampere/Blackwell and add a reproducer to perf harness + unit test that asserts no extra memcpy when toggling kernel.
Maya L.: Thanks. Also let's log kernel pick + kv_layout version in the request trace (console) so we can correlate in prod. :thumbsup:
Kevin P.: Agreed — will open small PR to add trace fields and the selector penalty.
Maya L.: Good plan. If anyone hits a different head-dim (e.g., 24/96) call it out; might be other alignment holes.
